input.summary: Narrow Section 8.2 exclusivity binding Ono to the defined Competing Product during the first 12 months of the term only, delete the post-termination tail, and carve out Ono internal Development and acquisitions.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an open-ended non-compete on Ono, including a post-termination tail of undefined length. We have narrowed the covenant to the first twelve (12) months of the term, deleted the post-termination restriction, and carved out Ono's internal Development and acquired products; the definition of Competing Product is unchanged.

ops.oldText: 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts. Prior to the [ * ], neither Ono or its Affiliates, nor Array or its Controlled Affiliates, shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory:
ops.newText: 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts. During the first twelve (12) months of the term of this Agreement, neither Ono or its Affiliates, nor Array or its Controlled Affiliates, shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory:

ops.oldText: In addition, in the event that Array terminates this Agreement for Ono's breach pursuant to Section 13.3 during the [ * ], or Ono exercises its right to terminate this Agreement "at will" pursuant to Section 13.2 during the Initial Royalty Term, then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
ops.newText: The foregoing restriction shall not apply to Ono's or its Affiliates' internal Development activities or to any Competing Product acquired by Ono or its Affiliates in connection with a merger, acquisition or similar transaction.

ops.oldText: in the Ono Territory during [ * ], Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: in the Ono Territory during such twelve (12) month period, Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.
